extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers, Scientific Review Administrators (SRAs), and grant applicants (investigators)
extracted.subtask_description: Collection of NIH Office of Extramural Research (OER) policies, procedures, and documents that define how applications for NIH support are reviewed, scored, and processed at initial Scientific Review Groups and by advisory councils. Includes conflict-of-interest rules, human-subjects/inclusion requirements, scoring procedures, and specialized guidance for various application types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objective of initial peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: The objective of the initial peer review is to evaluate and rate the scientific and technical merit of the proposed research or research training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial evaluation is performed by Scientific Review Groups (SRGs) composed of extramural scientists; managed by SRAs in NIH Institutes and Centers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-level peer review structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review takes place in multiple steps: an initial review by SRGs and a second level of peer review by NIH National Advisory Councils.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SRGs assess scientific/technical merit; National Advisory Councils provide advisory review and ensure representation from a cross-section of the U.S. population in deliberations and decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rosters of Scientific Review Groups (transparency of membership)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rosters of the membership of NIH Scientific Review Groups are available for standing review committees and Special Emphasis Panels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rosters provide transparency about who is evaluating applications and are accessible to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of the Peer Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level description of how NIH peer review is organized and executed across SRGs and advisory councils.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides links to detailed sub-guidance (glossary, procedures, reviewer guidelines, scoring) for reviewers and applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glossary of Terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard definitions of terms used in NIH peer review and application instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps ensure consistent interpretation of review criteria and procedures across reviewers and applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Procedures for Scientific Review Group Meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules governing how SRG meetings are conducted for peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers meeting logistics, conduct of reviewers, discussion formats, and administrative responsibilities of SRAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: General guidance for reviewers on how to evaluate applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes expectations for thoroughness, fairness, confidentiality, and use of scoring criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for Review of Specific Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Tailored reviewer guidance for evaluating particular types of NIH applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses unique considerations for different mechanisms, solicitations, or program-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of New Investigator R01s
rubrics_metrics.description: Special guidance for evaluating R01 applications from new investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include modified expectations or instructions to ensure fair assessment of early-stage investigators.

rubrics_metrics.name: CSR Scoring Procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: The Center for Scientific Review's specific procedure for assigning scores to applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines how numerical scores are derived and aggregated; referenced for consistent scoring across SRGs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streamlined Review
rubrics_metrics.description: A peer review process modification intended to focus discussion on applications most likely to be funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural variant used to make review efficient by minimizing discussion of lower-priority applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of Research Involving Natural Products (complex mixtures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for reviewers on evaluating research involving natural products usually prepared as complex mixtures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alerts reviewers to specific technical and methodological issues arising with complex mixtures and relevant evaluation considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Grant Application and Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and formatting guidance for modular budget applications and awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies modular budget units and related review/administrative processing implications for reviewers and applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children as Participants in Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and reviewer instructions concerning the inclusion of children in human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides assessment criteria and documentation expectations regarding justification, protections, and recruitment of child participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for New Investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools and guidance to assist new investigators in preparing competitive applications and understanding review expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes policies, scoring interpretations, and resources to level the review field for early-career applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated Criteria for Evaluating Research Grant Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH announcement of updated criteria used to evaluate research grant applications (see NOT-OD-05-002).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes comparison of updated vs previous criteria and Q&A documents to clarify application of the new criteria for reviewers and applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison of Updated and Previous Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: A document contrasting the updated NIH review criteria with prior criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to help reviewers and applicants transition to and interpret the changed review framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Questions and Answers about the Updated NIH Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: FAQ-style guidance clarifying how the updated criteria should be applied in practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides examples and interpretive assistance to reviewers and applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict Of Interest, Confidentiality And Non Disclosure Rules For NIH Peer Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies specifying conflict of interest, confidentiality, and non-disclosure obligations for reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes definitions of conflicts, required disclosures, and procedures to manage conflicts; available as PDF/MS Word guidance for reviewers of grant and contract proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Pre-Review Certification Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Form reviewers complete before participating in review to certify absence of disqualifying conflicts/conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used administratively to document reviewer eligibility before SRG participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Post-Review Certification Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Form reviewers complete after review to certify compliance with confidentiality and other obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to document completion and adherence to review rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions to Reviewers for Evaluating Research Involving Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific instructions (PDF) to guide reviewers in assessing human-subjects protections and related protocol elements in grant and cooperative agreement applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs reviewers to evaluate human subject protections, risk/benefit, consent, and regulatory compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Human and Animal Subjects Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Important notice to applicants detailing requirements and expectations for human and animal subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructs applicants on necessary documentation and reviewer expectations regarding ethical and regulatory compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Decision Trees for Human Subject Protection and Inclusion Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Decision-tree tools for reviewers to determine how to handle human-subject protection and inclusion policy issues during peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps standardize reviewer determinations on inclusion and protection questions with stepwise logic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Humans guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials (PDF/PowerPoint) providing detailed information on human-subjects protections relevant to peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports reviewer assessment of protections, consent processes, and regulatory compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Women in Clinical Research guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and materials addressing inclusion and evaluation of women in clinical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes general and Phase III-specific materials (PDF/PowerPoint) to help reviewers assess appropriate inclusion and analysis plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minorities in Clinical Research guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and materials addressing inclusion and evaluation of minority participants in clinical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes general and Phase III-specific materials to assist reviewers in evaluating recruitment, representation, and analysis for minority groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Children in Human Subjects Research guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials focused on evaluating inclusion, protections, and study design when children are participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides reviewer criteria for justification, assent/consent, and safety monitoring for pediatric research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data and Safety Monitoring Plans in Clinical Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for reviewers and applicants on expectations for data and safety monitoring in clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies when monitoring is required, what plans should include, and how reviewers should judge adequacy of monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rating of Grant Applications — New Explicit Statements of Review Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH announcement and materials describing explicit statements of review criteria used to rate grant applications (June 1997).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the formal criteria that reviewers must consider when assigning ratings to applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Oversight Group (PROG) deliberations on rating
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports and deliberations from PROG concerning the rating of grant applications and review policy decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical context and policy changes derived from oversight deliberations; used to inform current practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Regulations (42 CFR Part 52h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal regulations governing scientific peer review of research grant applications and research (final rules and Federal Register notice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal/regulatory requirements that underpin NIH peer review procedures and authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Notes (CSR publication)
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR publication containing new developments related to NIH review policies and procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Periodic updates and interpretations for reviewers and SRAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Advisory Committee (PRAC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory committee that provides counsel on peer review policies and practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRAC materials and recommendations inform OER policy and reviewer guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workgroups addressing regulatory burdens
rubrics_metrics.description: Historical workgroups established to identify and address regulatory burdens in peer review and grants administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents and recommendations from these workgroups inform streamlining and policy modifications.
